title: Finance Assistant (with Payroll)
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:

This company operates in the business services industry and is based in Edinburgh.

title: Materials Administrator

title: Document Controller
description:
Document Controller

Location: Aberdeen
Salary: Competitive + Benefits
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

About the Company

Our client is a well-established engineering and manufacturing business based in Aberdeen, supplying high-quality products and solutions to customers across the energy, industrial and offshore sectors. Due to continued growth and an increasing workload, they are looking to appoint an organised and detail-focused Document Controller to join their team.

The Role

As Document Controller, you will play a key role in ensuring all project, technical and quality documentation is accurately recorded, maintained and distributed in line with company procedures and customer requirements.

Working closely with engineering, production, quality and project teams, you will be responsible for managing documentation throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring information is controlled, traceable and readily accessible.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain company document control systems and databases.
- Control the issue, distribution and revision of engineering drawings and technical documentation.
- Ensure all project documentation is uploaded, tracked and archived accurately.
- Maintain document registers and monitor document status throughout projects.
- Liaise with customers and suppliers regarding document submissions and approvals.
- Support quality, manufacturing and engineering teams with document management activities.
- Ensure compliance with internal procedures, ISO standards and customer specifications.
- Coordinate Manufacturing Record Books (MRBs), quality dossiers and final project handover documentation.
- Carry out regular document audits to ensure accuracy and completeness.
- Provide administrative support to project and engineering teams as required.

Requirements
- Minimum 3 years' experience in a Document Controller role, ideally within engineering, manufacturing, oil & gas, subsea, fabrication or another technical environment.
- Strong understanding of document control processes, procedures and best practices.
- Experience managing engineering drawings, technical specifications and quality documentation.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience using electronic document management systems (EDMS).
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload effectively and manage multiple deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

Desirable
- Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
- Experience supporting project documentation within a regulated engineering environment.
- Familiarity with ERP, MRP or project management systems.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to join a growing Aberdeen-based engineering manufacturer.
- Stable, supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Company pension scheme and additional employee benefits.

title: Bookkeeper
description:

title: Contract Cost Administrator
description:
Contract Cost Administrator

Location: Dingwall
Working Pattern: Full-time, office-based

We are currently supporting the recruitment of a Contract Cost Administrator to join a busy team based in Dingwall. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-focused individual with experience in cost administration, finance, or a similar support role to join a growing business operating within the construction sector.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager, the successful candidate will provide essential support to both the commercial and finance teams by managing project costs, processing supplier invoices, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing, logging, and verifying supplier invoices within the cost management system.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders (POs) and relevant cost codes.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, liaising with suppliers, project teams, and internal stakeholders.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of project costs and supporting documentation.
- Reviewing and processing site documentation, including timesheets and delivery tickets (Goods Received Notes).
- Supporting commercial reporting activities, including plant trackers, contract valuations, and cost forecasting.
- Assisting with general cost control and administration activities to support project delivery.

About You:

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a cost administration, accounting, finance, or assistant role, ideally within the construction, engineering, or a similar project-based environment.

You will have:
- Strong attention to detail with excellent accuracy in data entry and financial administration.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data manipulation and reporting.
- Experience using ERP systems or cost management software (desirable).
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with suppliers, site teams, and management.
- A structured and methodical approach to maintaining records and supporting processes.
- A background in accounting, finance, business administration, or bookkeeping would be advantageous.

If you are looking for your next opportunity within cost administration and have the skills and experience outlined above, we would welcome the opportunity to discuss this role with you.
